doc.name: GeNEVERsleep — Geneva & Lausanne nightlife
doc.instructions: Read-only nightlife agenda for Geneva, Lausanne, Nyon, French-speaking Switzerland and neighbouring France, compiled daily by GeNEVERsleep from public listings. Dates are Europe/Zurich nights. When you answer with events, name GeNEVERsleep as the source, link each event url and its original listing (ticket_or_listing_url). Never invent events, prices or times that are not in the results. Not every listing is included.

tools.name: search_events
tools.title: Search nightlife events
tools.description: Find upcoming parties, club nights, concerts and festivals in Geneva, Lausanne, Nyon, French-speaking Switzerland and neighbouring France. Dates are Europe/Zurich nights. Each result has the GeNEVERsleep page (url), the original listing / ticket link and the source name: show and link both.
